title: Change booking form email input to use X symbol

requirements.text: Update the email input field in the Booking component (frontend/src/components/Booking.tsx) at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[5]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[2]/form[1]/div[1]/div[2]/input[1] to use 'X' as the input symbol/icon instead of the current implementation

quotes: edit the input in X sympol

acceptanceCriteria: The email input field in the Booking form displays 'X' as its associated symbol or icon
The input field functionality remains unchanged and still accepts email addresses
The form validation continues to work correctly for the email field

constraints: Only modify the email input field in the Booking component at the specified XPath
Preserve all existing form functionality and validation
Do not change other input fields in the booking form
nonGoals: Modifying the ContactForm component email input
Changing the booking form layout or other fields
